parole.significato: camper (a motor vehicle with a rear compartment for living and sleeping in)
parole.testo: From French caravane, from Persian کاروان (kârvân).

parole.significato: houri (a beautiful virgin girl supposed to dwell in Paradise for the enjoyment of the faithful)
parole.testo: Borrowed from French houri, from Persian حوری (huri), from Arabic حُورِيَّة (ḥūriyya).
